svg.text: Agents only improve through data: traces show what happened, demonstrations show what

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: good looks like, and feedback scores it. Keep optimization and evaluation data separate,

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: and run a flywheel (deploy, log, find errors, fix) that adds data on every loop.

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 智能体只能靠数据变好：轨迹记录发生了什么，示范说明什么是好，反馈给出评分。优化数据和评估数

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 据要分开，并让数据飞轮（部署、记录、找错误、修复）每转一圈都积累新数据。

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:11px
